'''Tahoota''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], selling gifts and other items.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tahoota appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Companion Gifts vendor on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
